summary: Practise sponsor alignment, manager actions and adoption tracking in a five-day course. Explore the outline and plan your next change initiative.
lede: Leading organizational change helps team leaders, change leads and functional managers coordinate people, decisions and day-to-day work during a transition. You’ll practise assessing impacts and readiness, clarifying sponsor and manager decision rights, and planning communication and adoption support using Kotter’s concepts, ADKAR and RACI. Exercises build a change brief, manager action and cascade plans, an adoption tracker and an executive progress brief, with attention to operational constraints and digital workflow uptake.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who guide change through teams, functional decisions and day-to-day work, whether they hold a formal change title or lead a change alongside operational responsibilities.
prerequisites: No formal change-management qualification is required. Familiarity with a team, process or technology change is helpful; coding is not required.
